text_block_list.text: Some time after Duramente's Make Debut—
—The day of the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

In front of the waiting room, Air Groove's 
mother and affiliates from her "school" 
had crowded together.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I didn't expect everyone to come along as 
well...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about? It's a big 
moment for "family," so of course we'd 
come to watch.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I-Is that how it works...?
choice_data_list: (That Alv is being taken advantage of...)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Even that Alf is no match for 
Mother when she gets into the mood.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
How are you feeling? Um, you seemed quite 
exhausted the other day.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay. That doesn't bother me anymore 
at all."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
If anything, right now... she's in the 
best shape she could possibly be.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: So—please, keep watching me.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!
choice_data_list:
Some tough competition is showing up, but 
we can handle it.

Some tough competition is showing up, but 
we can handle it, right?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. Well then, I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah―― Um, Alve-san!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Rob Roy-san. This is the first time 
we've spoken like this since the 
Takarazuka Kinen, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And so... I wanted to talk to you 
before the race.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I—am staking everything on this autumn!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Uni-san, and Kris S-san... Inheriting 
their feelings, I will bring my adventure 
tale to completion with this autumn 
triple-crown campaign.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Three consecutive races...? Does that 
mean—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: —The Autumn Senior Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Uni-san, unable to run due to an extended 
break... Kris S-san, who decided to 
retire...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
To properly color the tale of adventure 
etched with their feelings, nothing less 
than a battle of this caliber would do.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
S-So please...! Let us give it everything 
we have today...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Yes, I understand.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: And also—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Please tell Universe-san that we should 
run together again someday.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Y—Yes!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Mirako~ Just take it easy and glide your 
way to victory~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Geez! Couldn't you be, like, a little more 
supportive?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle's Friend
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, sorry!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
………… I never knew cheering could be like 
that...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: A-Ahahahaha...! I'm kind of sorry.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
“All my friends are pretty much like that, 
so...”

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
And yet... you don't seem to dislike it 
that much.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I've always lived a pretty easygoing life 
myself.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I don't really have any specific goal, 
either—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
We'd chat, play, watch TV... It was always 
just so normal.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I used to wonder, "What kind of potential 
do I really have?"... but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Even after I started running in big 
races, I couldn't see it at all. But――

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle Fan
text_block_list.text: Mirako-cha~n! Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...It's strange, isn't it? Even for 
someone like me, there are people out 
there who can dream like that.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Even though I'm nothing special or "one of 
a kind" at all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I think that's wonderful in its 
own way. Even if you're not special, you 
can still become someone's dream.”

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: So――do your best, more than usual.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Nice and relaxed, smooth and easy. I just 
might win this.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
They really run with so many different 
feelings in their hearts.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what kind of face the "me" from 
last year would make if she heard this...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Even so—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(They too—carry someone else's hopes on 
their shoulders.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Now I understand... The strength that is 
brought out for someone else's sake.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(And yet, now I know both 'strength for 
myself' and 'strength for others.')

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
There's something I want to do from now 
on, too.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
'To guide my juniors as their closest, and 
strongest senior'—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
In order to do that... the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn) and—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for back-to-back Queen Elizabeth II 
Cup victories.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I have no doubts. —I'm going all out!
